bubbles.title: Drop legacy compat
bubbles.hint: Analyze first: find all legacy-compat code (upgrades older tracks, legacy single-track mode), report it, human confirms before removing.

bubbles.title: Gate blocks corrupt track
bubbles.hint: Fog gate exits 2 when the current track exists but won't parse (keep fail-open only for real hook crashes). Message shows the way out: git restore .bubbles/<name>.json, or bubble switch <name>. .bubbles/ edits stay allowed. Docs: the gate is a workflow guardrail, not a security boundary (Bash isn't gated).

bubbles.title: Document what to commit
bubbles.hint: README: commit .bubbles/*.json (history + git restore as repair), ignore .bubbles/current (per-person pointer).

bubbles.title: Guard lost updates
bubbles.hint: Two agents writing at once can overwrite each other. Atomic writes protect the file, not the read-modify-write edit (needs locking or a version check).

bubbles.title: Split tracks.ts switch
bubbles.hint: Cosmetic: tracks.ts is one big switch — break it up.
